documents.transcription:
# Diagram labels and accessible transcription

This transcription records the supplied diagram's labels; it is not a fresh verification of its chronological claims. The coordinates are signed pair-center positions measured from January AD 1, not historical year labels.

## A. Two 8395-year frames

The same cross-Mirror span survives an opposite 460-year source exchange.

| Source settings | Left outer | Left inner | Right inner | Right outer | Adjacent spans |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| LXX cumulative OFF; SP / LXX regular OFF | −5290 | −3105 | +3105 | +5290 | 2185 / 6210 / 2185 |
| LXX cumulative ON; MT regular ON, Terah +60 | −5750 | −2645 | +2645 | +5750 | 3105 / 5290 / 3105 |

Both illustrated cross-Mirror spans are labeled 8395.

## B. Translated Flood and Shem positions

The 600-year source shift and 598-year translation leave a two-year displacement.

| Position | Start coordinate | End coordinate |
|---|---:|---:|
| MT Flood, translated | −6 | +1 |
| SP Flood, translated | −1 | +6 |
| LXX Flood, translated | 0 | +7 |
| MT Shem, translated | −8 | −1 |
| MT Shem, then reflected | +1 | +8 |

The fixed Mirror axis is January AD 1 at coordinate 0. The 7 + 7 junction is January AD 2 at coordinate +1.

## Coordinate key and source settings

- Nisan N BC has center −N; Nisan AD N has center N−1.
- Each ordered t/n pair spans center ±¼ year.
- Outer regular anchors: full 430; G1 Flood close.
- OFF/ON denotes Cainan.
- SP/LXX OFF uses Terah 0; MT ON uses Terah +60.

sourceGuide.title: Source guide for researchers and AI readers
sourceGuide.description: These documents contain information used or referenced in many of the numbered C-series research steps. If a subject or idea cannot be found in the 490d Unified Chronology Knowledge Catalog, consult this collection as another source of the underlying study material.

steps.label: Knowledge Catalog
steps.detail: Begin with the published Unified Chronology sources and controls.

steps.label: Study documents
steps.detail: Consult these supporting reports, registers, working drafts and diagrams for material beyond the published catalog.

steps.label: Research sections
steps.detail: Choose a subject and its bounded study sequence. Selected reports and section/sequence JSON indexes route directly to the relevant C-actions and linked evidence.

steps.label: Reports & sources
steps.detail: Search the numbered actions and their preserved source editions in the workspace; the public reading index also provides every record as a text page.

steps.label: Archive & Verification
steps.detail: Find original evidence packages, earlier editions and verification files when a study cites additional supporting material.

sourceGuide.editionRule: Use the edition and hash cited by the research step. These supporting files make the source material accessible; their inclusion does not promote every historical claim to an accepted conclusion or silently replace an earlier cited edition.
